about_text:
When another app wants to open a link, it asks you first.

· Allow once, or always allow
· Blacklist URLs you don't want
· Block an annoying app entirely

By        micr-07 · DeepSeek
Email     dogoolge@126.com
Version   {0}
app_block_confirm_msg:
Links opened by this app will be blocked from now on, with no more asking.

This is the strongest level of blocking, and you can undo it in “Blocked apps” whenever you need to.
app_block_note: Tick this to block every link opened by that app. Android 14 and above can identify the source app exactly; older systems do their best, and when the app can’t be identified the block doesn’t apply to that jump.
app_slogan: No more browser hijacking · bothers you only when needed
ask_title: An app wants to open a link
browser_list_empty_msg:
The system currently lets this app see only {0} installed apps.

Please open “System settings → Apps → App management → LinkGuard → Permissions” and turn on the “read app list / get installed apps” permission, then come back to this page and restart the app.

(The “Other browsers (system open with)” entry in the dialog isn’t limited by this and can be used right away.)
browser_list_empty_msg_short:
The system is currently restricting “read app list”, so no other browsers could be scanned.

Please allow “read app list / get installed apps” in “System settings → Apps → LinkGuard → Permissions”.
cb_ask: Ask me every time for URLs with no rule
cb_show_dialog_tip: When off: URLs on no list open straight in the default browser; if no default browser is set, the dialog still appears.
cb_toast: Show a small system toast when blocking
default_ask_each_time: Don’t use a default browser (ask me every time)
default_none: Not set (URLs with no rule will ask you)
empty_appblock:
No apps blocked yet.

Once you tick an app, every link it opens will be blocked and reported.
empty_blacklist:
The blacklist is empty.

URLs on the blacklist won’t open, only a small system toast is shown.
empty_whitelist:
The whitelist is empty.

URLs on the whitelist open straight away, with no asking — the browser used follows “Default open with”.

Tap the button below to add one; if a URL should use a different browser (an exception), add it and then tap that row to set it separately.
lists_tip:
Blacklist: blocked outright, only a small toast is shown, no screen at all.
Whitelist: opens straight away, with no asking; the browser used follows “Default open with”, and you can set a specific one in the whitelist.
App blocking: every link opened by that app is blocked.
opt_ask_every_time: Don’t remember, ask me every time
perm_no: Not granted, which may be why the list is empty
pick_default_title: Which browser to open with by default
pick_hint_after_always: Added to the whitelist. No default browser is set yet, so pick one for this open only:
pick_hint_once: No default browser is set yet, so pick one for this open only:
preview_zoom_hint: Range {0}-{1}. Bigger number = larger content, less of it visible.
row_show_dialog_sub: When off, URLs on no list open straight in the default browser
row_test_dialog_sub: See what it looks like with a sample link
row_toast: Show a small toast when blocking
row_toast_sub: Blacklisted URLs never show any screen
rules_empty: No rules yet. Tap the button below, or just pick “Add to blacklist” in the dialog.
scan_empty: ✘ No browsers found: the system currently lets this app see only {0} installed apps
scan_ok: ✔ Scanned {0} apps that can open links
search_hint_app: Search app name or package name
set_default_tip: Once it is the default browser, when other apps open http / https links they go through this app first, and you decide whether to let them through, pick a browser, or block them.
status_btn_settings: Not working? Choose it manually in system settings
status_default_no: ✘ Not the system default browser yet, blocking is not active
status_default_yes: ✔ Already the system default browser, blocking is active
status_no_desc: Only after you set it as the system default browser can it block links opened by other apps.
status_ok_desc: When other apps open http / https links, they all go through this app first.
toast_added_white:
Added to whitelist: {0}
It will open with “{1}” from now on
toast_app_blocked: Links opened by {0} are now blocked
toast_not_support_role: This device can’t request the role automatically, please choose it manually in system settings
toast_white_need_default: Added to whitelist: {0} (no default browser set yet)
use_default_browser: Don’t specify, use the default browser
val_scan_none: No browsers found, please allow the “read app list” permission
white_added_follow_default: Added to whitelist, will follow the default browser
will_open_ask: No default browser is set yet, you’ll pick one before it opens
